name: STAR Time — calendar dates and Julian day numbers (Julian, Gregorian, civil)
summary: Exact integer conversion between calendar dates and Julian Day Numbers in the Julian, proleptic Gregorian and civil calendars from JDN 0 to year 9999; identical to ERFA, CPython datetime and NAIF SPICE on 9014 dates, and dates that do not exist are refused.
reference: Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms, chapter 7: -4712 January 1.5 = JD 0; 333 January 27.5 = JD 1842713.0; 1582 October 15.5 = JD 2299161.0; 1957 October 4.81 = JD 2436116.31; 2000 January 1.5 = JD 2451545.0
reference_observed: all five reproduced exactly, in both directions

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-03: jdn, calendar_date, julian_date, weekday, day_of_year, CALENDARS
review.G-04: days; astronomical year numbering; Julian Date returned as (midnight JD, fraction of day)
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for non-integers, dates that do not exist, unknown calendars and values outside the valid range; no iteration
